summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi AMZN 2x Daily ETF (AMAA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN), which operates global e-commerce platforms, provides cloud computing infrastructure through Amazon Web Services, offers digital streaming services, and sells digital advertising inventory. AMAA was launched on Jun 26, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
